verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents 'Creating custom rules' for transaction categorization and auto-categorization (up to 98%), which act as automatic rule-based actions on incoming transaction events, plus AI Close automation for month-end tasks. However, this is scoped narrowly to bookkeeping/categorization events rather than a general-purpose rule/trigger-action framework spanning arbitrary business events. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader event/trigger system beyond categorization, documentation of conditional logic complexity, and independent confirmation these rules work reliably beyond marketing claims.
